title: Skip the Line: Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia Guided Tour
description: Barcelona’s Park Guell and Sagrada Familia can both draw lines in excess of two or three hours. This skip-the-line, small-group tour lets you bypass the lines at both Gaudi creations, so you spend less time waiting and more experiencing the Catalan architect’s genius. Plus, rather than explore independently—and having to arrange travel between the two sites—you get a guide for extra insight and convenient transport laid on.

reviews.usertext: This was the highlight of our stay in Barcelona and good value considering that it included the high price of the skip the line tickets at both attractions. Other trips charge you extra for those. Alberto was a terrific and knowledgeable guide and we were able to go straight into both attractions with no queue/line. In Sagrada Familia, we had headphones so that he could speak into the device and we could hear him despite the crowds and wander about to take photos - no shuffling into groups and trying to hear the guide. It was interesting even for the teenager accompanying me. This tour sells out fast, but if you are too late to book it may be worth turning up at the Parc Guell gate Carrer d'Olot, 24, 08024 at 9.30am (there is a queue even then) to see if they are taking on any extras. The groups were still very small but there were 3 or 4 guides with this company, each taking a small group and the groups got together just for the transport by coach from Parc Guell to Sagrada Familia. For those with walking difficulties Alberto was very careful to point out any uneven ground/steps and places to rest.

Very informative tour Alberto was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating. Alberto took the time to answer any questions as well as recommend other activities such as restaurants and other museums. I wouldn’t hesitate to book again if I knew Alberto would be the tour guide.

Suzie is fantastic! Without a knowledgeable guide to offer artistic and historic context, these amazing cultural treasures will a beautiful jumble to most visitors. Suzie helped it all make sense-even our teenager thought this tour was a highlight of the trip, thanks to our amazing guide. Being able to skip the line and have these sites explained is worth twice the price. Thanks, Suzie!

Because of transportation, difficult in an unknown city, we were ten minutes late and the group had already left, complete as the person at the entrance of park Guell said. In fact, in the end, we were seven persons out of thirteen who had to purchase a second entrance ticket to enter the park.
We rejoined the group at Sagrada Familia and the tour was very comprehensive.

I have done many tours in many lands. Most of them produce a pleasant or even fine experience. But the truth is that after one or two weeks have passed, I will likely not remember the tour. This tour is indelibly carved in my memory. How can you not be blown away by Gaudi?! So original, so out of the box extraordinary, so passionate. And the commitment in Barcelona to finish what he started at La Sagrada Familia!!!
But this tour was over the top excellent because of our tour guide, Alberto: a charismatic, personable, sensitive man who speaks at least five languages. He remembered all our names after our introductions. He introduced all the group members to each other as we arrived and said where we came from. Secondly, he made history come alive. Thirdly, he was very sensitive and caring about us and any physical limitations: pointing out railings during climbing stairs and seating availability at various stops. Despite all his multi-tasking, he noticed when I had a coughing fit and stopped to offer me a throat lozenge. Now you may think that all tour guides are like Alberto but I know that this is not so. There was a group of five staying at our hotel who had taken the same tour the day previously but with a different guide. They were so disappointed when they heard our report. While they agreed that their guide did the job and did it well, it felt differently - not so relaxed or personable.
So, hats off to Alberto and to Barcelona Local Experiences. Thank you!

Fabulous tour with our lovely friendly guide. Her knowledge about the building and its history were second to none. And there was no waiting around in the queues. I’d thoroughly recommend this to anyone . The only minor criticism is that it was quite expensive so I was disappointed that it did not include entrance to the tower which I understand gives brilliant views over the church and the city.

Our tour guide, Violetta was outstanding. She had so much passion for the history of Barcelona and did an amazing job on our 4 hour tour of Parc Guell and La Sagrda Familia. She was friendly, funny, and personable. We loved the intimate size of the tour and would highly recommend this to anyone looking to visit these two incredible sites.

Olga Escribano was our guide on this tour and WOW, what an amazing experience! It's true joy to meet such passionate as she is! Olga met us in front of the Park Guell and we went via fast entrance, no que. She shared her love to Catalunya and Barcelona in such an amazing way! We immediate felt inspired to read more about Antonio Gaudi and his artistic life and work. From Guell we were taken by private us to Sagrada Família.
Olga showed us those hidden spots, and without taking longer breath she was telling so many fascinating stories about Barcelona, Gaudí and amazing "Barcelona's baby - Sagrada Família". It was true joy to fall in love with this amazing city and its "growing baby" thanks to Olga's passionate stories.
Not only it was a unique experience to walk in the steps of Gaudí with Olga, but she also gave us lots of tips and culinary suggestions. What a great gift of passion and work she has, that she kept our full attention as well as answered all our questions in this over 4,5 hours tour.
So if you'd like to book Park Guell + Sagrada Família tour, please make sure to ask for OLGA to be your guide. She's true Catalunyan, speaks 5 languages, is a licensed Barcelona tour guide and loves what she does. My absolutely BEST recommendations to this tour if guided by Olga Escribano ❤️
We booked via Airbnb

She was very knowledgeable and detail oriented. It was great for our older crowd but a bit dense for our younger group. Four hours was a tad long we’d recommend bringing a snack and your walking shoes! If you really want to hear the details and rich history this trip is for you but if you want a more laid back experience I would recommend trying another. My mom who was an art history major loved all the details and interesting theories that she could share! I definitely left knowing so much more about architecture and Barcelonas culture.

I just took a tour of Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia with Olga this morning and enjoyed (“Gaudí”-ed) every minute of it. Her ability to share her knowledge with her passion for the history and art kept me engaged during the tour. She even took our photos for us since we were traveling as a couple and answered all my questions. Finally, she even recommended local places and experiences for us and helped build our culinary itinerary. Looking forward to coming back to visit and will schedule tours with Olga every time.

Highly highly recommend spending your travel day with Olga!

We had the BEST tour of our entire trip due to Olga!! We booked 7 different tours during our visit to Spain and this is by far the one we enjoyed the most. Olga did an excellent job of explaining the sights and was very articulate and knowledgeable. She knew where the best photo opps were and stopped and offered to take photos of each of the groups. Plus, she expertly framed the photos and patiently waited for other people to pass by. She provided restaurant recommendations and was willing to answer all questions - tour related or not. She kept our group on track without feeling rushed. Olga is a true professional with a very positive and outgoing perspective.I can tell Olga is passionate about sharing her knowledge with visitors and genuinely loves what she does. I highly recommend this tour!!

Also want to add that this tour company actually honored its small group limit. There were 8 total and max limit was 12. The other tours we booked exceeded their maximum which diminished our experience.

This was our first trip to Barcelona and we wanted to make sure and see these amazing masterpieces by Gaudi. A guided walking tour seemed like a hassle-free and convenient way to go. We met our friendly and knowledgeable tour guide, Macarena, and she pointed out the history and features of Park Guell and the Sagrada Familia, while giving the group some time to take pictures and explore on our own. They bring the group from the park to the cathedral via bus. Overall an excellent tour, you are then free to remain in the church and visit the crypt or take more pictures once she was done, I highly recommend this tour.

Hi. It was simply perfect! Sensational experience and our guide was exceptional. She had great knowledge and she kept a 75 year old couple and my 13 year old daughter captivated for 4 hours. Simply perfect day!

Very enjoyable tour. We did this as a 2 part trip with Sagrada Famillia. We had to meet the guide at 10 at the park. This is easy to get to. We got the metro from Liceu to Lessops and then it was a 20 min walk to the park follow the address on google maps and you can’t go wrong. Park is also sign posted from metro.
We did the park first and in my opinion the best way round it was cooler first thing so nice to walk around. Our guide was Vincent there were 12 in our group approx. Vincent was friendly , knowledgeable and the best thing passionate about the park and it’s designer Gaudi. He gave such a lot of fascinating information and made us feel enthusiastic about the park to. The park is quirky and definitely is a must visit I highly recommend this trip and if you get Vincent as your guide you won’t be disappointed.

This was a fantastic tour. I am not one to go on organized tours often and I found this to be extremely worthwhile. The tour guide, Alberto, was full of knowledge and I got so much more out of Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia by going on this tour than I would have exploring individually as a solo traveler. I appreciated that there was time for individual exploration during both parts of the tour.
Alberto’s wit and knowledge kept the tour interesting and he even had restaurant recommendations for the area after the tour- one of which I tried and it was amazing!! Super appreciative of the experience. Would most certainly recommend it. Thank you!!!

The tour was great! We had Vincens as our tour guide and he was brilliant. He explained everything with so much passion and enthusiasm that he made it really interesting and helped us understand Gaudi much more than if we just went to these places alone. He had also some great tips for nice photo spots. It was great to have the fast track, so no waiting in queues and the transfer between sites worked out perfectly. Thank you very much for an amazing 4 hours exploring the beautiful architecture style of Gaudi in these two masterpieces that are the Sagrada Familia and Park Güel!

We had the absolute most incredible experience yesterday on this tour with Olga. She is so genuine, passionate and knowledgable. She brought magic to the experience for us, and she actually talked to us for a long time after the tour finished to answer questions about Catalan culture and Barcelona. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone! We came away from the tour feeling so grateful for having had the experience. - Charlotte and Brendan

We had a fabulous experience with Victor as our guide to see Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia. He was there early. He listened and answered all of our questions - was in no hurry and was totally invested in our enjoyment of both tours. The bus between the tours was comfortable and roomy. Touring the park first gave us full insight into the creativity of Antoni Gaudi so we were able to enjoy the cathedral even more. We could remain in La Sagrada Familia as long as we wanted after the tour to get lots of pictures and take time to really experience the building and the light through the windows. I would recommend this tour to everyone who comes to Barcelona.

This tour was so well organized and our guide Roberto was so knowledgeable and helped to make us appreciate Gaudi and his work on a whole new level. I loved how it was a small group(only up to 12 people) and that they arranged transportation between the two sites. This is the way to see these two incredible sites!

This was one of my favorite tours. The basilica is stunning, and I'm so glad we were there with Albert, who was an excellent tour guide. He provided us a lot of interesting info, and was able to explain the artwork in detail, drawing our attention to pieces we might have missed without a guide. I thought Park Guell was nice, but Sagrada Familia was easily one of the highlights of my visit to Barcelona.

Olga was fantastic! She was so informative and engaging with details that you would have missed had you gone alone without her as your guide. She was very patient and moved at a good pace. There was an 8 year old boy that clearly was not interested in being on the tour with his parents but Olga engaged him and he really enjoyed the visit.
Also doing both the Park and church on one day was not too much and we liked checking both off the list of must see things in Barcelona as their locations were not convenient to the waterfront where we were staying.
Highly recommend! Ask for Olga

Also Olga gave us an extra 15 min of her time to guide us through the museum at the Church and offered her help on our stay as needed.

This was an excellent exposure to the Park Guell and Sagrada sites designed by Gaudi. Our guide was affable but low content without as many historical details that we appreciate. We recommend these sites very much and their enjoyment is certainly helped by the guide

The best way to visit Park Guell and La Sagrada...Martha, our amazing tour guide, was nothing short of exceptional...her extensive knowledge, behind-the-scenes "hidden" history & expertise made the tour one of the best we've ever experienced.
About the only mistake you could make is Not to book this tour.
Please note: Park Guell is rocky, hilly and challenging (especially for those with limited mobility).
PS. If La Sagrada doesn't architecturally amaze and blow you away, you'll be the sole exception to the rule. A trip to Barcelona that doesn't include these two Gaudi crowned jewels would be nothing short of a shame.
Kudos to Martha and Barcelona Local Experiences for a wonderful tour.

our tour through Guell Park and La Sagrada Familia was truly amazing. Our tour guide, Vicente, was excellent and this guide tour is really what you should do to understand the history and artists vision in what was created so many years ago. Very worthwhile

Our guide, Albert, was absolutely amazing. We had a blast walking through Park Guell, and were told interesting history and facts along the way. Albert frequently offered to assist a family with a stroller navigate the steps in the park, and even offered to take photos for everyone in the group. From Park Guell we took a short bus ride to La Sagrada Familia, and received the same detailed history and colorful stories about the church and everyone involved in it’s (ongoing) construction. Albert was also helpful with related questions, and even recommendations for dining and other interesting spots.

This is well worth the money. We are so glad that we decided to take this trip. The Parc Gruell is a beautiful mix of nature, architecture and engineering. The story behind Gaudi’s creation and vision was told to us expertly by our guide Olga. She was amazing, entertaining and great fun, nothing was too much trouble for her. After the tour of the parc you are guided to a private bus which then drives you a short distance down into the city to see Segrada Familia. Nothing can prepare you for it’s magnificence, both when you catch a glimpse from the outside and when you step in through those huge doors and see the enormity and beauty of it. Olga is fantastic is explaining the history of the tallest church in the world and about Gaudi’s life and the construction process.
It was truly wonderful, even though i’ve had the tour, I plan on returning and doing it again.
Thank you Olga for such a great day.

This is a "must see" tour if ever there was one. The park is a drive away from the city centre and you will get the entire history of the park and its beginnings. Our guide was David and he was wonderful, very knowledgeable and able to answer lots of questions. There is a fair bit of walking on uneven ground which you might want to note if any of your party is elderly or unsteady on their feet. There are spectacular views and the park is quite unique and well worth a visit.

We left the park and got a bus to La Sagrada Familia and honestly the place is amazing. It is still under construction and David was able to tell us all about that. Before we went inside he pointed out the adornments on the side we entered from which had the Nativity. David explained all of the figures, pillars, statues etc and highlighted their details.

We moved inside and I cannot find the words to do it justice! The light and the Majesty is breath taking and David was able to steer the mind so that you could absorb it all and marvel at the architecture and engineering. I loved it.

Paula was an excellent guide, and we enjoyed her commentary and knowledge of the Park Güell and Sagrada Família. They must be seen. The reason I gave a 4 instead of a 5 is because they should make it known that this tour is not for people with mobility issues. The Park has many stairs and uneven walking. We assumed the coach bus would take us directly to the Sagrada Família, but it turned out to be quite a walk to get there, so they need to make that known also. I'm not sure if this was an exception, but no one mentioned it, so I assume it's the usual. Having said that, I recommend this group. It was small, 12 total, so you were able to hear everything Paula was explaining, and she was very good.

Lots of information, lovely tour guide (David) very well versed, lots of walking, I dragged my 80 year old mom and my 72 year old aunt. The park is hilly, has inclines and rocky areas, plenty of steps to navigate. Views are totally worth it at the top. Bathroom and gift shop are extremely busy and there was not enough time to do both before transferring to Sagrada familia so if you want to shop you will have to do it quickly, luckily the gift shop is small. What can I say about the sagrada familia, breathtaking, awe-inspiring. As a piece of art, we could spend days there and not be finished seeing it, as a religious relic, well for that stuff, you’d have to ask my mom. I was there about 15 years ago and it was still under construction. Scheduled to be finished around 2028, so will definitely go back, again with a guide cause otherwise you miss too much, but then stay and enjoy it cause it really is just magnificent!

Park tour was VERY strenuous (continuous steep climb on uneven surfaces). The description does not mention this. The park is a great example of Gaudi’s work. Transfer to the church was quick and comfortable. The church is beyond belief; you could spend 2 days there and not absorb it all. Again, lots of walking, but not strenuous. Our guide spoke fluent English, albeit hurried. Our purchased pass for the Guell park instructed us to look for a “burgundy umbrella “ to locate our guide. He failed to bring it, which caused unnecessary confusion. We were also given detailed instructions on “what not to wear inside the church”. Most tourists, and our guide did not comply with the suggested dress code.

Our tour guide Marta was by far one of the best guides I’ve ever had in my touring experiences. She was highly informative, incredibly friendly, and she made sure everyone in the group was attended to by answering all of our questions. I couldn’t be anymore grateful for having had Marta as my guide, especially as this was my first time in Barcelona!

A fantastic tour made all the better by our friendly and knowledgeable tour guide Olga. Olga took the time to make a personal connection with each of us, was able to answer all of our questions, and even provided us with restaurant and other recommendations for the remainder of our trip. She also recommended great photo spots and took photos for each group on our tour. I highly recommend this tour (and suggest you request Olga!).

Olga was AMAZING! She was extremely passionate and energized and informative about all things Gaudi. My wife and I really enjoyed her company and the tour as well. The tour was in English and it was very well researched. We will be back in 2030 and hope she’s still around to show us the completed La Sagrada Familia!!

Beautiful park and cathedral. Reflects the creativity of A. Gaudi. The park is whimsical reminiscent of something from Dr. Seuss. The basilica is unique, complex, and modern. The contrast between the old and new facade are provocative. Best visited with a guide who can help unwrap the subtle beauty and meanings of this architectural marvel. Our guide Albert was excellent. Would highly recommend.

Everything we wanted. The history, culture, and all the beautiful sites. David C was an excellent guide who was informative, funny, and kind (he went out of his way to help someone who was not even part of our group recover a lost item). Highly recommend booking this tour and requesting David C!

Marta was our guide and her knowledge as a local professor was clear. She shared a lot of history and great recommendations for the remainder of our trip.
The total tour of Park Guell and Sagrada Familia was nearly 4 hours, mostly on foot - walking or standing. Luckily temperatures were not too hot on our tour day. I definitely recommend a morning tour start. Ground in the park was uneven, bathrooms available but limited so expect a line. The small cafe at the end of the park tour was good to get a drink and popsicles to cool off.
Highly recommend as one of your first activities in Barcelona. This will set you up for subsequent sightseeing and a great trip

Olga is the perfect guide. She is passionate, very clear explanation, the rhyme was good, she is friendly and kind, and was able to make us all in a good mood. She took all the time needed to answer all of our questions that are related to the tour and related to the city of Barcelona in general. 100% recommended.

Hands down one of more memorable tours from our 4mths trip. Olga was incredible!! She was very knowledgeable, helpful, and incredibly passionate. It is evident that she loves what she does, and genuinely wants to connect people with this incredible history and experience of Gaudi.

Highly recommended to get have a guide for the Guell Park and the Sagrada Famiia experience; we would have missed so much of the history without a guide. We learned about the deeper meaning, stories, and more about Gaudi's life. Very worthwhile. Ask for Olga if you can!!

Our guide David was very good. He knew a lot about both locations and had a good sense of humor too. We appreciated our small group of 12. We did have to wait for 10-15 minutes for the private bus to take us from Parc Guell to Sagrada. We were not told why and we did not expect to have so wait. Plus it was raining and cold and windy! Not good!! At the Sagrada, we waited outside for at least 25 minutes to enter. This was NOT skip the line. NOT what we paid for! Again, no explanation or apology, AND it was raining, cold and windy!! Once inside, which was a full hour later, after leaving Parc Guell, we felt rushed. It was really a shame. David checked his watch a few times, and left our group 20 minutes before the stated end of our tour time. So we ended up having him as our guide at Sagrada for just under one hour. NOT what we expected and certainly not what we thought we were paying for. I definitely recommend taking a small group tour guide for these magnificent places. We did learn a lot and enjoyed David very much. Just not sure this particular company is the best choice in terms of actually getting what you think you are paying for.

Olga was amazing!!! She was very knowledgeable and you could tell this was her passion. I was traveling alone and she made me feel like I wasn’t alone. She made sure all those who was traveling alone were able to get pictures and she was a great photographer! Highly recommend this tour, especially with Olga!
Five ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This was our first time doing a private tour - there were few options remaining for less expensive options, but we really wanted to see Sagrada laFamilia so e we paid the free.

We were met at our hotel by the tour guide, Anna, and a van that drove us to Park Guell. The tour guide talked to us as we strolled through the park and we had plenty of time to stop and take pictures. We entered the park on the side where the tour buses are parked and excited through the front gates where our driver was waiting for us.

We were then dropped off at the basilica. Our scheduled entry time was 40 minutes away so we strolled around the basilica so that Anna could show us each facade. After a short break we entered the basilica for the interior tour. The entire tour was completed about 30 minutes earlier than planned, but we did not feel shorted at all.

Our guide was friendly and spoke very good English. She knew her history well and was willing to engage in conversation. If you are able to request a guide, definitely ask for Anna!

Sagrada la Familia is probably the most splendid cathedral we’ve ever seen. Instead of feeling oppressive and displaying the commanding power of God, Sagrada is light, expansive, and welcoming. It’s a truly refreshing and stunningly beautiful testament to what the Christian faith could be.

I highly recommend taking this tour - you will not regret it!

There is nothing like La Sagrada Familia! Our tour guide did an excellent job of showing us highlights of the church, but really, one could spend days there looking at the architecture, lighting and ambiance. The so-called small group transportation between La Sagrada and Park Guell ended up being a large bus with several tour groups combined, but that was a small hiccup. Park Guell was also great fun, and could easily be a whole day experience. Our guide was knowledgeable and friendly. All in all a great day.

Alberto was our incredible tour guide. He was such fun and was full of excellent knowledge of the park and of the cathedral. I especially appreciated his knowledge for religious history. And since it was extra hot and humid that day, he accommodated us by gathering us to shady areas while he talked. We really enjoyed his sense of humor and his enthusiasm.

Excellent tour, very organized, would highly recommend. Our tour guide, Alberto was absolutely fantastic. Very knowledgeable, caring, and courteous. We enjoyed this trip very much and especially enjoyed having Alberto use a microphone so that everyone could hear him throughout the tour. Would highly recommend this tour to get the most out of your visit.

Alberto did an amazing job as our guide! He provided great details and information about La Sagrada Familia that you would not know just touring by yourself. He did this at a great pace and also did not overload us with too much information. You cannot go to Barcelona and not go see La Sagrada Familia. I highly recommend this tour and again Alberto was fantastic!

We spent 7 days in Barcelona and this was one of the items on our list, so I booked the tickets in advance. The tour was very well presented and very organized, timings are not to be taken lightly. Be forwarned, there's quite a bit of walking on this tour. It was great for us as the weather was cooperative.

We were two couples out of the 12 people that took this tour, and they provided a wheelchair for me at La Sagrada Familia. This was the best tour, out of the five that we took. The tour guide was wonderful and made sure that I was in position to experience all that should be seen and heard. You could tell that she really liked her job. This tour is a must when in Barcelona! The park was good, but the church was fantastic!

Olga did a great job with enthusiasm and passion. She interacted with the poeple of the group of 12 really well. With us speaking English her accent was a little hard to understand at times and I understand people with foreign accents better than any of my other 4 family members.

She really likes giving tours as it is evident in the way she expresses things and goes into details. Try to get Olga for your tour if possible.

P.G. was fine, a little drab for me but I know there were other family members that really enjoyed that segment of the tour and didn't like so much L.S.F. church so it is really what you like as a person. I, personally, liked the church so much more and wish I could have stayed longer, but security closed the church down for the day for evening services. I would have stayed another hour or so longer if I could have.

Olga was magnificent. She is very knowledgeable about Park Guell and Sagrada Familia. You can really tell she loves what she does. This was one of the best tours we’ve ever had. She really made it interactive for the kids who made it through the entire tour without complaining!

The charm and humor and infinite knowledge our guide - Olga brought to the tour. So many aspects of both Park Guell and La Sagrada were presented to us in a fascinating way. Olga was able to answer any questions and brought a spiritual understanding of the work of Gaudi which changed the mind of one of my companions about Antonio Gaudi. I hope I live to see the Sagrada completed. Thank you Olga

I'm glad I booked this tour. Made it much easier to gain access to both sites as opposed to waiting in line or booking online without a guide. Our guide, Alba, was AMAZING! I enjoyed her enthusiasm and positive energy throughout the tour. She made sure all members of the group were together before moving to different areas. And she made time to answer any questions we had. The Sagrada Familia and its history and architecture was hands down one of the most interesting experiences ever!! Definitely wear comfortable walking shoes. There are some hills and step climbing involved at the park.

OLGA was so fantastic and was one of the best your guides I've ever had. She took extra time at the end of the tour to get to know us and give us recommendations of things to do in the city. She was so kind and knowledgeable which made the tour 100 times better.

If you want to do this tour, you have to request Olga as your guide!!! You wont be disappointed!!

They tried to contact us by email but only 1 person got the email and was not able to make time offered to reschedule. ALL 12 people showed up and tour was canceled. We found our 45 min. after meeting time. When we tried to get our money back they told us WE didn't show up! We finally got our money back because we had documentation. We were able to find a tour available of just the La Sagrada Familia and loved it! We found someone right there to book a tour.

I highly recommend this tour. Our guide was Marka (not sure of the spelling) and she was really cool. Her knowledge and easy personality made the tour flow really well!

Our tour took place during a heatwave, so was really tough out in the sun for prolonged periods. The tour of Park Guell can be quite taxing on people with limited mobility or fitness.

The Segrada Familia was mind blowing, I could have sat outside (in some shade) and just looked at the exterior for hours! Inside was equally as good and we were fortunate enough to hear the choir singing, which topped off a great tour.

Both elements of the tour were thoroughly enjoyable!

Mark was an excellent guide. He was very knowledgeable about the art, architecture and history of both Park Guell and the Segrada Familia.

He really helped us fully appreciate the art and design that went into both landmarks and to truly understand Gaudi's vision.

There was a nice break in between to grab a quick meal also which was nice. Would totally recommend this tour, especially Mark.

Our guide, Olga, was so full of passion and pride for La Sagrada Familia (we only did that tour) her energy was infectious. We were 2 adults and 2 children (7 and 9) and all of us were captivated for the entire tour. The Basilica is extraordinary and without a guide you would miss or misunderstand so much - Olga had a fact or detail about every inch. Seeing Gaudi and the details through her eyes was a wonder!

Wow. What a great introduction to an important set of masterpieces of Barcelona. Our tour guide, Fernando, was amazing. His knowledge of Antoni Gaudi and of Park Guell and Familia Sagrada was truly extensive.

We had a much better appreciation of the history and the art of Gaudi as a result. Also, Fernando was very considerate of the physical abilities of the members of our group -- taking time as needed.

We were lucky that the day was only in the mid 80s (F) as you are outside most of the tour. Be aware that there's a fair bit of walking too (and steps). And definitely take advantage of the breaks to refuel with food & water as it's a full 4 hour tour.

Our guide was the best guide we have ever had ANYWHERE!

We took many tours all over Italy, and ended with Barcelona.
I feel we were the luckiest group to have
Perez' Alberto 3110.

His kindness with 2 children on the tour was a highlight to watch. He was patient, and very informative of everything we were able to see.

He made the tour fun! He had a passion I never saw in any other tour guide. I actually wanted to put him in our suitcase and him back to Oregon. His positive attitude, knowledge, and kindness convinced us that "Trip Advisor" provided a special gift to us in having Perez! Thank you for having such an outstanding employee. They are hard to find.

The Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia was worth every minute!

It was a great experience visiting Park Guel and La Sagrada Familia with tour guide Olga. She was a great tour guide, she is very communicative, and her english skills are on the highest level. All recommendations 👍

We had the best time with Susana on our tour. We learned so much about Gaudi and the history of Barcelona as well. She made sure that my teenaged daughters had fun which is a huge win! She has great energy and pointed out highlights big and small so we really felt like we didn't miss a thing. She always gave us the chance to ask questions, stop to take photos, use the restrooms (the ones that didn't have a line!) and she just really ensured that we had a good time as well as learned things that we would likely not have learned unless we really took the time to read on our own before we visited these amazing places! She also gave us some other tips for our trip and it's clear that she really loves her city and all of it's beauty!! Thank you so much!!!

Alberto is the BEST guide! He is knowledgeable about the sites and the city, and watches over his charges with care and gentleness. He will ensure everyone’s needs are met. He is kind and respectful, and obviously loves his job. His height also makes him very easy to find him in a crowd! I will remember what he taught us, and hope we have him again when we return to see the progress on this beautiful church.

Olga was a fantastic tour guide. Friendly, clear, knowledgeable. She took every necessary COVID precaution to make sure all of us on the tour were safe and comfortable. I would absolutely recommend her to anyone interested in seeing Park Guell/La Sagrada Familia and learning more about Gaudi and Barcelona generally.

This was a great tour and our guide, Hector, was very knowledgable and spoke english very well. The weather was so incredibly hot so it was nice that there was a private air conditioned bus to take us from the park to Sagrada Familia. I went with 3 other young adults and we felt that we learned a lot and were very glad we did a tour and didn't just walk around/buy tickets independently.
The only complaint would be the meeting point- its in an obscure place and we were 5 minutes late. Google maps does NOT take you the proper way to get there. Overall, I would recommend this tour to travellers in Spain!

Ably led by the warm and articulate Alberto, our small group of 11 were guided around both the park and basilica at a pace suitable to taking in the stunning sights. Alberto was extremely informative and imparted his knowledge in an engaging style, always taking care to find a shady spot and getting the best photo opportunities. It’s definitely worth taking this relatively exclusive guided tour- we’d have never known what to look out for otherwise.

Of our many highlights from our trip to Barcelona, this was one of the best.

It was a fascinating insight into the life and works of Guadi and a must see for anyone visiting this amazing city. In particular, Vicenç our guide was very friendly as well as extremely knowledgeable and passionate about Guadi.

Perhaps our only suggestion would be to be able to go back a spend more time in Park Guell afterwards.

Really cannot recommend enough.

Amazing and comprehensive tour of the park and catedral. Albert was an exceptional guide and took the time to point out specific features and bits of information. He also gave us tips on how to make the best of our experience there, whether it was how to take pictures or things we could relate to from which country each of us were from.

Would recommend to anyone for a welcoming and beautiful experience in Barcelona!

Xavier was full of info about the extensive history of both of these historical sights. We were lucky to have cooler weather than recent days as both of these stops get quite crowded— but Xavier knew how to navigate and made this a pleasant informative experience. A must if you visit Barcelona

David was fantastic. A local guide with fabulous knowledge, a sense of humor, and ability to engage everyone in the group. He is proud of his Catalan heritage and put all the beauty of the Parc and the Basilica into perfect context. Skipping the line was TOTALLY worth it. It was pretty crowded but felt like we got the VIP treatment all around. He even told us personal stories about his childhood memories of the Parc as well as the best time to come back to the Basilica. Couldn’t of asked for anything more. He was Perfect. And the tour was very well organized with the 10 min air-conditioned bus ride from the first stop to the second just what was needed. Bring water or find a minute to skip out to the gift shop to buy some. It gets hot. A nice day filled with amazing experiences. Well-worth the price!

Fantastic tour. Susie was a great guide who brought everything to life and was very informative and funny. She pointed out things we would never have noticed otherwise. One of the best guides we've had on any tour.
Be aware that the meeting point is at the top of a steep hill at the entrance to the Park, so allow extra time to get there if your fitness isn't the best.
The tour includes a bus from the Park to the church.
I recommend the afternoon tour as there were less crowds and the light in the cathedral was incredible.

Gloria our tour guide was knowledgeable and experienced. The park and cathedral were amazing and a must see when visiting Barcelona. I gave 3 stars because the bus driver was an HOUR late picking us up! Had the driver notified Gloria we would have spent this time in the park instead of waiting around. This was extremely rude and very unfortunate. For this reason I would not recommend this tour especially if you have mobility issues and need to sit down. Find another bus driver!!!!

Favourite part has to be Sagrada. It's just amazing. Whilst the ceiling is, of course stunning. I thought the light from the stained glass windows was spectacular and the part I loved the most.
Park Guell is lovely and the mosaics just beautiful. However, for me there were too many steps!
Just remember that if steps pose a problem you need to be aware of this. Myself and another chap declined the chance to climb further steps to the main vantage point. It didn't matter for me as we had a super conversation waiting for the others to meet up with us. This has to be a consideration for people with breathing/mobility problems.
I met two Australian sisters who were great company. An extra bonus for me, so thanks girls.

If you are lucky enough to get the Tour Guide Olga I can assure you that you will have an amazing your. Her passion for Gaudi is evident the moment the tour begins. She brings such knowledge and genuine love of this man’s life work. I was also quite impressed with how she interacted with all of us touring. She answers questions, took photos, ensured we were at a pace that well suited the entire group. She was born and raised in Barcelona and really knows a lot about the history of the town as well, the relationship Gaudi himself had with the people of the region. Olga is a wealth of information and you’ll rank this a top excursion.

Despite the bad weather David got us through and we had a very nice time he was extremely knowledgeable and made the experience fantastic. Without a tour guide you really miss out on a lot of the special items at both the park and the church. I highly recommend it

This tour with Olga Escribano is incredible. Gaudi’s work is stunning but it was so enhanced with someone as knowledgeable and passionate as Olga. This was one of our top experiences while in. At elk a. We wish we could have Olga tour us through the whole country. Highly recommend.

It was wonderful to see both sites without having to wait in line and to get a private tour, but not worth the price we paid (which was $330 pp) just to get private transport and a quick way in. We went during peak season but the price wasn't worth it. Our guide was nice, and it was great to have someone take our pics for us, but the information wasn't anything beyond what I could've read up on my own. Definitely get tickets to skip the line, but you don't need to get a private guide or transport.

We enjoyed out 1/2 day trip visiting this beautiful place. Having tickets in hand was such a convenience, Our guide spoke English very well - kept us informed - gave us our free time - and kept track of the tour group. He was very well informed of the Sagrada Family Basilica.

This was a great tour and a wonderful experience made even more amazing by our tour guide Alberto. Albert was extremely knowledgeable and full of energy and really made the buildings come to life. We have visited many churches and cathedrals, but the Sagrada Familia was out of this world and knocked spots of all the others. Highly recommend this tour!!

Too wet to do the Park Guell part of the tour although it was offered. We all declined! Not the fault of the tour operator. They couldn't control the weather unfortunately and we were too wet to do this part of the tour.
Good and informative tour in that it explained the meaning behind many parts of the building and about the life of Gaudi which we would have missed had we had gone on our own.

for the cost pick up and drop off at the hotel should be included. meeting location was confusing as to where exactly to meet. tour guides were 20 minutes late so people where getting nervous. we wanted to tour the park and sagrada familia so ordered tickets only to find out they sent the familia sagrada tickets. if the guides had shown up 15 minutes ahead of time we would have been able to make the second tour. needless to say the guide could not help so she called the office. we spoke to them and they said there was nothing they could do. we managed to get tickets to the church for 21 euros instead of the 151 euros. for the 130 euros reading about the place is best

Fernando was a great tour guide and provided ample time to take in the sights of Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia. We truly enjoyed his knowledge on not only the sights but also Gaudi. His energy was high and engaging during our tour making the time fly by seamlessly. We look forward to another tour in the future!

Olga Escribano was a wonderful guide. She made the experience of learning about Antonio Guadi Park Guell and Basilica Sagrada Familia come alive. She immediately remembered everyone's name in our group and where we from. Olga especially looked after my husband my me as we are seniors. She was fabulous and very caring.

Amazing tour and our tour guide, Olga, was the best! Lots of great information and the pace was great for us. I had read past reviews and before booking and hoped that I got Olga as our tour guide-and we are so happy we did! She kept the group interested and tailored the pace to the group/ability. She kept us in the shade for all our stops and briefs and knew a lot of information.

If you are debating doing a tour, this is the one! We were at both locations for enough time and having transportation between the two was nice. I was able to keep up and I am out of shape. I recommend wearing comfortable walking shoes, but not needed, as we had someone in our group do it in flip flops.
We debated between doing this on our own due to reduced crowds, but are happy we didn't! Great tour/guide, easy booking, and friendly group!

It was supposed to be a pick up from our hotel. The day of the tour we were sent a text to meet the guide at the park . Since we had not planned this it was a hassle to get there and then they weren’t there. They had sent us the wrong text so we had to wait for them to arrive which took a a while
The guide was the worst we have ever had . He had very little to say and mostly just stood there and waited for us to ask questions. He was boring and seemed not interested. We would have gotten a lot more information with a self guided tour. This was a HUGE waste of money and time. I would definitely NOT recommend this tour.

La Sagrada Familia is highly visited and getting the skip the line pass is the way to go. Also having an experienced guide makes it a richer experience. This tour was only 2 hours with the guide but you can stay as long as you want afterwards.

We had Ester as our tour guide and had a fabulous time. I had been to Barcelona and seen both Park Güell and La Sagrada Familia 15 years ago and this was infinitely better than trying to learn the history and symbolism on your own or through the audio guides. Ester was engaging and very knowledgeable, providing a thorough history of the locations and of Gaudí. Would highly recommend!!! Ester also gave us some great restaurant recommendations!!

Wonderful experience with top notch guide! First class transportation picked us up at our accomodation on time. Our enthusiastic and knowledgable guide Alberto kept us entertained with stories of Barcelona and the great visionary Gaudi. Highly recommended!!

The tour was amazing and our guide was so knowledgeable about all of the history and stories related to the tour. She was absolutely awesome. I would highly recommend this tour if you love Gaudi and the La Sagrada this is the tour for you. Gloria was over the top and he sure to request her amazing lady and so smart!!

This tour is a great experience! Our tour guide, Marta, was very fun. She had a great understanding of the history of the park and the church. I'd definitely recommend doing this tour so that you can get the history behind all of the interesting sights.

Enjoyed this tour. It almost didn't feel like enough time as there was so much to see. The tour guide Vincent was very enthusiastic about what he was telling us. A lot of walking. If you have trouble with stairs, walking or inclines, this is not a tour you want to do. The original meetup place was also a little confusing as I couldn't find clear markings on the buildings for the address of the meetup spot. Otherwise, it was a very good tour.

What we paid for this tour was worth every penny! Both Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia have so much detail that we would have missed much of it if it were not for David, our outstanding guide. When we arrived home, we received an email from him with the answers and some great pictures he has taken over the years he has guided. In my opinion, that is true dedication and professionalism. It was a wonderful experience.

This tour operates by Barcelona Local Experiences, I booked this tour cos they got lots of positive reviews, pleasant tour, no rush, on time, all in English. Our tour guide is Marta Folch, is native Catalonian, very informative both Park Guell, and La Sagrada Familia, she start the tour on time with 5 of us, while the rest of the 11 people late for 15 minutes, but she did not left them out either, good job. She answer all our questions, and share her favorite restaurants, eat like a local, with us, which we did try a few. Highly recommend this tour.

Hong Kong

Our guide was Cristina Monja and she did an excellent job. She paced the tour well. Provided a lot of great information. Whenever we had questions about Güell, or Gaudí or Barcelona, she was able to answer. She knew such intricate details that made the experience more fulfilling.
Seeing Park Güell and La Sagrada Familia is a must. Don’t miss this amazing tour.

Absolutely amazing experience, it definitely helped us get the most out of both locations knowing the history behind them. Christina our guide was extremely knowledgeable and friendly, she made the whole thing come to life.

You are on your feet for the majority of the 4 hours (and it was 4 hours almost on the dot) so make sure you bring comfortable footwear.

Would definitely recommend to first time visitors or even if you’ve been before but want to understand a little more.

Excellent tour. Thank you to our tour guide Susie for a great time and great information. You will get see and understand the beauty and meaning of these pretty places at a great pace with a friendly guide. The meet up point is uphill walk so be prepared for that. The tour starts at Park Guell and then a bus takes you to Sagrada Familia.

We toured in a small group with Victor on 10/29/2021. He was a “perfect” guide. He kept the group moving and was willing to answer all of the questions we had. We had a problem with our taxi getting us to the right entrance. We called right away and he answered the phone! We were 10 minutes late but he waited for us. He had a lot of interesting facts and stories to share. I would recommend a warning about all the stairs in the park.

We are so happy that we did this tour, it made everything so easy, and we learned so much about both the park and the sagrada familia that we would’ve never gotten on our own just walking around. I know the park. Güell has some mixed reviews, but I think that’s from people who did not have any sort of guide or information to help them understand the beauty and the meaning of the place. Silvana our guide was amazing. We had a group of ages 13-80 and all had a wonderful time.

The word magic ✨ describes well the visit we had. Our guide Olga, a passionate and exciting person, shared with us with great joy all the little things that we would not necessarily pay attention to. These 4 hours spent with her went by at a crazy speed! Without any hesitation I advise you to do this tour with our pink lady Olga.

My tour guide Olga was kind and showed us around la sagrada familia and park guell. I was so pleased and inspired by the architectures and the meanings of them, thanks to Olga’s amazing guide. I would recommend this tour to learn and enjoy Gaudi’s architectures in Barcelona :)

My husband tested positive for Covid the day of our tour. I explained to the guide the situation and he refused to give us a refund because it was outside of the 24 hour cancellation policy .
Most travel companies have generous policies when it comes to COVID.

I will contact my credit card to dispute the charge. I am extremely disappointed!!!

Ester was a very good tour guide and we really appreciated having a very small group (only 6 people) which was so easy to walk round with when there are lots of tourists around. La Sagrada was fabulous and we would not have understood or learnt so much about it through an audio tour. Ester could not have done more to make the visit so wonderful.

I really liked this tour. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and personable, and she did a great job of keeping track of everyone. The crowds were pretty dense, but these are two must-see sites in Barcelona. I was glad we saw them this way.

The group was small and enjoyable. The sites was a total delight. Laura was terrific! She really enjoys her job. She was full of knowledge and was able to convey with clarity. She was also very personable and able to create a great report with all of us. Also very professional.

We booked a private tour because the group tours were full. We loved the private tour! The tour guide, Veronica, was knowledgeable and personable. We got so much more out of the experience than we would have on our own. The guide picked us right up from our hotel and had a driver to take us to Park Guell and the La Sagrada. We got a taxi to take us back to our hotel. The tour does not come with a ticket to go up in one of the towers of La Sagrada so be sure to book that separate if you want to do that. We never had to wait in any lines and were able to get right in to see everything.

We had an absolutely amazing time! Our tour guide Olga was extremely knowledgeable, charismatic, and entertaining. She greatly enhanced our experience of both Park Güell and La Sagrada Familia by explaining the precise details that would have otherwise been lost on us. Cannot recommend this tour and guide enough!

This was a fantastic tour! I highly recommend taking a guided tour to see Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia. The architecture of both are pretty on their own, but the history and facts that the tour guide gave made it a hundred times more interesting and rich. Olga was a great guide! Very energetic, fun, and knowledgeable!

Booked a personal tour months ago for September 2022. The day of the tour they cancel and tell us the church is closed because of a festival. We went there via a bus just to see the outside and noticed they were not closed! Of course tickets were sold out so we could not go in. Not reliable and dishonest.

The tour was about 80-90 min long and was very interesting and informative.

The guide Albert was very good and was able to handle a large group well. We used headsets and could hear him very well.

I would recommend him.

Our tour guide Gloria was amazing! She spoke great English and was very entertaining. She answered everyone’s questions enthusiastically and had a great sense of humor. Highly recommend this tour, definitely worth it.

We booked our tour in advance to be sure we are able to get to the Park Guel and Sagrada Familia, because last time we were not successful.
Tour started at Park Guel and our guide Olga was fantastic: she told us many fascinating detail and facts about the sight and when we later on continued to the Sagrada familia, she even offered to take us through the museum after our tour was over.
Olga made our tour a great experience. She was truly amazing and made the tour much more enjoyable.

I had a great time on this tour and learned a lot about Gaudi, Sagrada Familia and Parc Guell. Olga was very knowledgeable and friendly. She made sure that we also had time to explore the sites on our own, which I appreciated. One thing to keep in mind if you book is that you must have your shoulders covered at Sagrada Familia, so make sure to bring a cover up if you have a sleeveless shirt or dress on.

Amazing guided tour! Our guide Olga Escribano was fantastic. Super animated, incredibly knowledgeable, and kept us all engaged. She knew everything you could possibly have wanted to know, and offered to take pictures for anyone any time they wanted. She knew all the best spots for photos and sent us away with a list of recommendations for great spots to eat. 10/10 would recommend Olga and this tour to anyone!

Olga Was our tour guide, she was incredible very informative and knew what she was talking about the whole tour. Olga knew the perfect spot to take picture and amazing views. She was also very kind to give us recommendations on where to visit while staying in Barcelona!!!!!

I cannot recommend this tour enough! Me and my partner had the best time. The tour guide Alberto was knowledgable, friendly and charismatic making every moment enjoyable. The day was well planned with suitable amounts of time given to each element to make sure you didn’t miss a single moment of beauty. Thank you so much for a great day!

Of course the attractions speak for themselves, but what made this tour especially enjoyable was our guide Nayada. She was so upbeat and funny, as well as very knowledgeable. In addition, she had a folder with additional photos and information explaining the various components of the tour. The tour itself was as magnificent as expected; I felt our guide elevated the experience.

Our guide, Olga, was so knowledgeable about Gaudi and the history of these places - it was fascinating! Park Guell was a planned community ahead of its time and no words can describe La Sagrada Familia. It is a truly spiritual experience. You. Must. Go.

This is a great tour and Olga was an amazing tour guide. She was thorough but kept the tour moving. Her knowledge and insight of Gaudi’s work was really helpful. The tour itself was the perfect amount of time; we saw everything but didn’t feel rushed. Also, this is a small tour - no person walking in front of 20 people with headphones. It was very easy to ask questions. You can do both Sagrada Familia and Park Guell on your own, but you won’t get the background information that makes it so interesting. Thank you, Olga!! We had a wonderful time.

Great tour, Albert our tour guide was welcoming and informative, having an extensive knowledge. Consideration was given to latecomers, those slower on the tour and those needing a rest. Both park guell and sagradia are amazing, and well worth a visit.

My husband and I are home based travel agents. We have traveled extensively and have organized and led our own international group tours. OLGA Escribano is one of the best guides we have ever had. She was extremely warm and personable, providing us excellent overview of these 2 beautiful sights. Would highly recommend this tour and guide OLGA. She tried to accommodate limitations of some of group

David was terrific. He remembered everyones' name. He was really friendly and knowledgeable. In the rare incidence he didn't know the answer to a question he found out the answer quickly. He kept on schedule and when my partner got separated from the group he managed to help out and stay organized. Great tour all around.

Thank you for a very nice tour. Olga was really kind and passionate, her experience made a great difference to enjoy these impressive monuments. It make a big difference to have a guided tour with someone as experienced as Olga.

What a wonderful experience with our tour guide Ester! We skipped the line at Park Guell and Sagrada Familia and the transportation was also included. We would recommend this experience and the tour company for the organization and thank you for the small group tour. Hope to see you soon in Barcelona!

Great tour guide! Albert was very detailed, and the tour was a lot of fun! Learned a lot about Gaudí’s work. If you plan on taking the bus or train, plan to leave early, the meeting point is not the easiest to get to. You have to walk a very steep street a few blocks from where the train drops you off.

We had an amazing tour of both Park Guell and the Sangrada Familia. Our tour guide Marta not only was so knowledgeable Of the history and life of Gaudi and how he influenced Barcelona, she made it fun and interactive. She was awesome! We had a small
Group of 8 which was perfect. We had a perfect amount of time to see both, get pictures and ask questions. A must see in Barcelona.

Details of tour and where to meet were very confusing, so if you book only the Sagarda Family of the Park Guell and Sagarda Familia you will need to remember that the day of the tour. I was on site 20 min after tour started because of the confusion on where to meet and they said they tried to reach out, which they had not and couldn’t do anything else for me. But yet I bough tickets on my own and was in the church in another 8 min.

A truly wonderful day spent at these amazing places.
We had a great tour guide David and he was so informative.
We were with a nice group of people from various parts of the world and David remembered all of our names!
Thank you for a great day

My mother and I went on this tour July 31 and had a wonderful experience. Our tour guide Olga was absolutely wonderful! We have had many tours over many years and the tour Of Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia was by far one of the best ever. That was due to our knowledgable and fabulous guide Olga. This is a pretty thorough tour of Park Guell and Sagrada Familia. Silvana was very nice and explained everything well and with humor. She was also very knowledgeable about the history of both places. The four of us did this combo tour which takes about 4 hours. Our guide David was excellent! Super friendly, very knowledgeable, and seems to really love Barcelona. You are walking or standing almost the entire time so wear comfortable shoes!

Think our tour guide was Silvana. She was so enthusiastic and knowledgeable about Gaudi, and made the tour really very interesting. A truly excellent tour and one I would definitely recommend anyone visiting Barcelona to do. Definitely do a skip the line tour as both Park Guell and Sagrada Familia were very crowded. The company was well timed and organised. Definitely 5 star!

Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating. Park Guell was a fantasy world of mysterious creatures, fanciful architecture and a park unique in all the world.

Our guide expertly ushered us through the park with patience and shared countless details along the way.

Our trip to Sagrada Familia caught me by surprise. I’m not religious but I have a spiritual side that is fed when I’m in nature. We loved the tour. Our tour guide Alberto, made the tour. He is an extremely knowledgeable local, friendly and easy to understand (in English). Both Park Guell and Sagrada Familia were amazing. We have a much better understanding of Gaudi and his talents. Sagrada Familia is the single greatest architectural masterpiece I have ever seen. David was a very good guide, but a bit challenging to understand at times.

Our guide, Vincents (sp?) was probably one of the best guides on any tour we have been on in the last ten years. He made the history of the park and the church really come alive. If we go back to Barcelona, we will try to find him for another tour, he was that good!

I really enjoyed visiting and learning more about Park Guell and Sagrada Familia during my short trip to Barcelona. Our tour guide Olga was excellent. She was friendly, attentive, professional, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend her tour if you ever happen to be in that great city!

Olga was a brilliant guide, so passionate and knowledgeable. I’ve been to Park Güell and Sagrada Familia three times and this was by far the best experience I’ve had learning about them. Olga engaged our group the entire time and made this an unforgettable day. The interior of the Sagrada Familia was truly stunning, nothing else like it in the world. Don’t hesitate to book this tour and ask for Olga!

Tour was great. The group was large but they broke us up into four smaller groups. Transport between sites was via motorcoach. Quick and easy drive. Our guide, Fernando, was informative and friendly. Definitely worth it to skip the lines at both locations.

Fantastic tour! Olga was highly attentive, informative, fun and so friendly. We did the park and Sagrada option, which was roughly 5.5 hours. Learned a great deal about the sites with Olga, and she takes you to locations for great pictures, as well as offers to take them.

I am sure there are plenty of this type of tour as we saw other groups but we were fortunate enough to get Albert as our guide. He was knowledgeable but didn’t talk down to us. We missed seeing the interior five years ago when we were here because we didn't have tickets. That was a sad miss for me. This time we were traveling with our oldest daughter and secured tickets beforehand. It is so unique and worth going to!

Our guide Olga was terrific- personable, knowledgeable, enthusiastic and animated. She made this incredible experience even more enjoyable. If you are visiting Barcelona- this is a must. Vincent was absolutely wonderful. Well worth the guided tour. So much history to see and learn. This was a short tour from 12-3. Perfect amount of time if you’re looking to explore a lot of the city in a short visit! This was truly the perfect way to go to see these historic places in Barcelona!

Olga made our tour of Gaudi’s most famous works very memorable. She was very engaging and caring. We learned a lot and always had a front row view for all the main points of interest. Bus air conditioned between Park Guell and Sagrada Familia. Thank you!

This tour is a must!
From start to finish this was a great tour.
We were met on time and our guide, Jamie, was so knowledgeable and helpful.
We learnt so much about Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia.

Barcelona is beautiful, and this tour gave us more information and experiences than we could have ever gotten on our own from Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia.
